description: Use when you want to SELL tokens to a buyer who posted an RFQ: sends a sealed quote (token amount and total ETH price) that only the buyer sees. Returns a quoteId. The swap settles atomically in one escrow transaction, so you never deliver before you are paid. Not for listing prices publicly. Signed: the first call returns a message to sign; call again with the same arguments plus timestamp and signature.

address.description: Your wallet address (the buyer or seller). Required.

dryRun.description: true = only check the request, nothing is created. Optional.

idempotencyKey.description: Unique key (8-64 characters) so a retry never creates a duplicate. Optional.

signature.description: EIP-191 personal_sign of `message` from the previous response. Leave empty on the first call.

timestamp.description: From the previous bull_* response. Leave empty on the first call.

webhook.description: https URL that receives events: quote.countered, quote.accepted, quote.rejected, deal.buyer_funded, deal.settled (optional).

name: bull_send_quote
